rules.message: ValidateComplexType and ObjectGraphDataAnnotationsValidator come from an experimental package. ValidateComplexType without that validator validates no nested field, and nothing reports it.
rules.fix: Call builder.Services.AddValidation() and put [ValidatableType] on the root form model in a .cs file. Keep the old pair only in an existing form that uses both parts, and suppress with that reason.
match: [Required, ValidateComplexType] public Address ShippingAddress { get; set; } = new();

rules.message: RegisterOnPersisting with TryTakeFromJson is the old form of persisted prerender state. It needs a key, a subscription, and Dispose.
rules.fix: Put [PersistentState] on a public property and load with Data ??= await .... In an app with _Host.cshtml, keep the old form and suppress with that reason.
match: _persisting = state.RegisterOnPersisting(() => { state.PersistAsJson("products", products); return Task.CompletedTask; }, RenderMode.InteractiveAuto);

rules.message: The NotFound render fragment of the Router is deprecated in a Blazor Web App, and the build gives no warning. With NotFoundPage on the same Router, each request fails.
rules.fix: Set NotFoundPage="typeof(Pages.NotFound)" on the Router, remove the NotFound fragment, and call NavigationManager.NotFound() for a route without data. In an app with _Host.cshtml, keep the fragment and suppress with that reason.

rules.message: A Router with NotFoundPage and a NotFound fragment fails on each request: "Setting NotFound and NotFoundPage properties simultaneously is not supported".
rules.fix: Remove the NotFound fragment. The NotFoundPage component shows the not-found content.

rules.message: A Blazor Web App that serves its files with UseStaticFiles gets no fingerprints, no compression, and no cache headers for its build assets.
rules.fix: Call app.MapStaticAssets() before MapRazorComponents<App>() and reference files with @Assets["app.css"]. Keep UseStaticFiles next to it only for files outside the build output, for example uploads.

rules.message: This is the Blazor Server hosting model with _Host.cshtml. It still compiles on .NET 11. An existing app keeps it (BLZ-09). A new app does not use it.
rules.fix: In a new app, use AddRazorComponents().AddInteractiveServerComponents() and MapRazorComponents<App>().AddInteractiveServerRenderMode(). In an existing app, leave it, or move it as its own task after decision BLZ-09.
